Develop genotypes into phenotypes

Source: R/develop.R
develop.Rd

Integrates the regulatory dynamics from a starting expression state until a steady state is reached. The steady state is checked for stability.

Usage

develop(
  model,
  genotypes,
  x_start = NULL,
  tol = 1e-10,
  tmax = 10000,
  maxsteps = 1e+05,
  check_stability = TRUE
)

Arguments

model

A `grn` model.

genotypes

Matrix of genotypic values, one row per individual and one column per locus (see [loci_names()]), or a single vector.

x_start

Starting expression states (matrix with one row per individual, or one vector used for all). Defaults to `model$x0`. When the network has several stable states, this determines which is reached.

tol

Relative tolerance on \(|dx/dt|\) at the steady state.

tmax, maxsteps

Limits on developmental time and integration steps.

check_stability

Check that the steady state is stable.

Value

A list with `X`, the full gene-expression matrix, and `status` (0 = stable steady state, 1 = no convergence, 2 = unstable steady state, 3 = non-finite values).
